noun:Ysop.tx: From Middle High German isôpe, ysôpe, from Old High German isopo, isipo, variant declension of hysop, from Medieval Latin hȳsōpus, hȳssōpus, from Latin hȳsōpum, from Ancient Greek ὕσσωπος (hússōpos).

noun:Yperit.tx: Borrowed from French ypérite, from Ypres.

noun:Yak.tx: Borrowed from English yak, from Tibetan གཡག (g.yag).

noun:Yard.tx: 18th century, borrowed from English yard. Doublet of Gerte (“riding crop, whip”). Masculine gender after Meter. Feminine gender after Elle (“ell”).

noun:Yeti.tx: Borrowed from English yeti, from Tibetan གཡའ་དྲེད (g.ya' dred, “rock bear”)

noun:Yoga.tx: Borrowed from French and English yoga, from Sanskrit योग (yóga, “yoking, union”).

phrase:you name it.tx: Borrowed from English you name it.

noun:Ypsilon.tx: Ultimately from Ancient Greek ὖ ψιλόν (û psilón).
